title: Kagamine Len — Ideal Protagonist〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks for bringing over a copy of your movie for us, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I did promise to bring it over once it was finished. Anyway, let's watch it together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can't wait to see how the story we helped you come up with turned out☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A film directed by Nene! I'm so excited!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Quit playing up the whole “director” thing...
Okay, I'm hitting play now.

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line:
“Far in the future...
A series of disasters has led humanity to the brink of extinction...”

rows.Speaker: Wandering Cook
rows.Line: “I'm just a humble cook...”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, it's Akito!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa! Did you see that roundhouse kick?!
I could hear his leg go all whoosh!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The Dark Cook got blown away by that blast! That was so cool☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. No matter how many times I see it, the cinematography here astounds me. Taking this scene using drones makes it feel so much more dramatic.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, it has quite the impact!
This must've been very hard to actually pull off, no?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Cool, strong heroes like this really are awesome!
I wanna know what he does next on his journey!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I also wanna play a character like him...)
After the screening

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you all for watching...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thank you for showing us! It was a great film, Nene! I'm glad we got to see it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Time really flies by when you're having fun! The hero was so cool, and so were the stunts...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Nene! Are you gonna make a sequel?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? A sequel?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sorry...
I really appreciate the interest, but I doubt that's gonna happen.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, that's understandable...
This involved your entire class, so it won't be easy to make another one...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, let's make it ourselves☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, you guys are gonna make it...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yup☆
What do you guys think?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sure. It could be fun to make a film for a change instead of putting on shows!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm in too♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, I wanna play the Wandering Cook!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm gonna play a super cool hero like him!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay♪
Then, Len can be our hero☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, what else do we need to do?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I wanna be the director☆
That's such a cool title!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Then, I'll be behind the camera...
Let's do our best to make our actors look as good as we can, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll be counting on you two!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is starting to sound like a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, I'll need to bring over some film equipment that you can all use.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, and the clapperboard! You've gotta say, “Action!”♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Nene, you're gonna be the first one to watch it once it's done!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It's gonna be so cool!
And just as good as the one your class made, if not better!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, then...
I'll be looking forward to seeing it.
